what: hir-ty-codegen's unit tests did not compile on all-1111: `wasm.rs`'s test module called `iconst`, `iadd` and 28 more without `InstBuilder` in scope and `FunctionBuilder::finalize` without its argument (32 errors). No unit test of the crate could build, the edit fuzzer (`v2/edits.rs`) among them.
cost: twenty minutes; and the fuzzer that holds incremental builds to clean ones was not running for anyone
cause: a test module written by a lane that could not build it; nothing compiles test targets before a merge
workaround: fixed here in three lines (the import, the two `finalize` arguments)
state: fixed on revisions-1111; open: the gate should compile every test target (`cargo test --no-run`) of the crates a merge touches
